headline: A trained concept generator raises reported pass@128 on filtered hard-math sets
summary: A paper trains a 7B concept generator with reinforcement learning to propose reasoning strategies for a frozen larger answer model. On a 1,000-item DeepMath hard subset selected for zero Qwen2.5-32B success in 128 prior rollouts, the authors report pass@128 of 39.2% versus 19.0% for repeated sampling at the same answer-rollout allocation; on a similarly filtered Omni-MATH 2 set, they report 18.60% versus 11.29%. A limited transfer evaluation reports a smaller gain when steering Llama-3.3-70B. These remain author-reported, task-filtered benchmark results: evaluation reuses the Qwen answer model as judge, training reward estimation is compute-heavy, and no independent reproduction or broad cost advantage is established.
